AT-86        AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Valve Body)

3.  TURN ASSEMBLY OVER, REMOVE SET BOLTS AND
    REMOVE TWO VALVE BODY COVERS AND GASKETS

4.  REMOVE PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE
    (a)  Remove the bolt and retainer.
    (b)  Remove the spring and steel ball.
    CAUTION:  Cover the spring with your hand. Slowly remove the bolt, being careful not to pop out the spring.

5.  REMOVE NO. 3 SOLENOID
    (a)  Remove the bolt.
    (b)  Remove the solenoid from the bore.

6.  REMOVE NO. 1 AND NO. 2 SOLENOID
    (a)  Remove the three bolts, the solenoid and gasket.

    (b)  Remove the two springs from the bore.
